name: Asana
label: Asana API 1.0
description: Asana API 1.0 via OfficialApiNode (nodes/asana/api_spec.json). Official Asana REST 1.0 (app.asana.com/api/1.0). PAT or OAuth access token as bearer. OAuth app review for production distribution. Official docs: https://developers.asana.com/reference/rest-api-reference. Secrets never appear on OUTPUT. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Asana official API call. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Set operation plus the path/query/body fields that operation lists in api_spec.json. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"project_create"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP verb to run. Overrides instance operation when non-blank. EXACT accepted values: 'project_create', 'project_get', 'project_list', 'project_update', 'project_delete', 'task_create', 'task_get', 'task_list', 'task_search', 'task_update', 'task_delete', 'task_move', 'subtask_create', 'subtask_list', 'comment_add', 'comment_remove', 'tag_add', 'tag_remove', 'project_add_task', 'project_remove_task', 'user_get', 'user_list', 'listen'. listen/trigger/webhook_listen never open a socket — they return an error telling you to use a BPMN message event. Example: 'project_create'.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Asana `data` envelope escape hatch for write ops. Purpose fields (name, notes, due_on, assignee, tag, text, …) merge into data via bodyMap and win on conflict. Custom/rare keys stay here. Example: {"custom_fields":{"123":"x"}}.

schema.label: name
schema.description: Task or project name. Required by Asana on project_create / task_create / subtask_create unless supplied inside data. Nested as data.name. Example: Q4 launch.

schema.label: notes
schema.description: Plain-text notes for project_create/update, task_create/update, subtask_create. Nested as data.notes. Example: Kickoff Friday.

schema.label: html_notes
schema.description: HTML notes (Asana rich text) for project/task writes. Nested as data.html_notes. Example: <body>Kickoff</body>.

schema.label: due_on
schema.description: Due date YYYY-MM-DD for project/task writes. Nested as data.due_on. Do not send with due_at on the same task. Example: 2026-12-01.

schema.label: due_at
schema.description: Due date-time ISO-8601 UTC for task_create/update and subtask_create. Nested as data.due_at. Example: 2026-12-01T17:00:00.000Z.

schema.label: start_on
schema.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD for project/task writes. Nested as data.start_on. Example: 2026-11-01.

schema.label: color
schema.description: Project color on project_create/update. EXACT: dark-pink | dark-green | dark-blue | dark-red | dark-teal | dark-brown | dark-orange | dark-purple | dark-warm-gray | light-pink | light-green | light-blue | light-red | light-teal | light-brown | light-orange | light-purple | light-warm-gray | none. Nested as data.color. Example: dark-blue.

schema.label: privacy_setting
schema.description: Project privacy on project_create/update. EXACT: public_to_workspace | private_to_team | private. Nested as data.privacy_setting. Example: private_to_team.

schema.label: archived
schema.description: Archive flag on project_update. Nested as data.archived. Example: false.

schema.label: html_text
schema.description: HTML comment body on comment_add. Nested as data.html_text. Use instead of text. Example: <body>Looks good</body>.

schema.label: tag
schema.description: Tag GID for tag_add / tag_remove. Nested as data.tag. Example: 1234567890.

schema.label: section
schema.description: Section GID on task_move and project_add_task. Nested as data.section. Example: 1234567890.

schema.label: insert_before
schema.description: Neighbor task GID on task_move / project_add_task. Nested as data.insert_before. Example: 1234567890.

schema.label: insert_after
schema.description: Neighbor task GID on task_move / project_add_task. Nested as data.insert_after. Example: 1234567890.

schema.label: task
schema.description: Task GID on project_add_task (required) and project_remove_task (required). Nested as data.task. Example: 1234567890.

schema.label: project_gid
schema.description: Project GID path for project_get/update/delete and project_add_task/remove_task. Example: 1234567890.

schema.label: opt_fields
schema.description: Comma-separated Asana opt_fields for project_get/list and task_get. Example: name,due_on,assignee.name.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Page size 1–100 for project_list, task_list, task_search, user_list. Example: 50.

schema.label: offset
schema.description: Pagination offset token from the previous list response (not a number). Example: eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QifQ.

schema.label: task_gid
schema.description: Task GID path for task_get/update/delete/move, subtask_*, comment_add, tag_add/remove. Example: 1234567890.

schema.label: project
schema.description: Project GID. Query filter on task_list. Body data.project (required) on task_move (addProject). Example: 1234567890.

schema.label: assignee
schema.description: User GID, email, or me. Query filter on task_list. Body data.assignee on task_create/update and subtask_create. Example: me.

schema.label: workspace_gid
schema.description: Workspace GID path for task_search. Example: 1234567890.

schema.label: text
schema.description: Search text for task_search (query). Comment body for comment_add (data.text). Example: kickoff notes.

schema.label: completed
schema.description: Task completed flag for task_create/update and subtask_create (data.completed). Also query filter for task_search (true|false). Example: false.

schema.label: story_gid
schema.description: Story/comment GID path for comment_remove. Example: 1234567890.

schema.label: user_gid
schema.description: User GID path for user_get. me is accepted. Example: me.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Handler result object. Success: status='ok', http_status, data (parsed JSON). Example: {"status":"ok","http_status":200,"data":{}}. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: Status
schema.description: Present on HTTP 2xx. EXACT value: 'ok'. Example: 'ok'.

schema.label: HTTP status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status code. Example: 200.

schema.label: Data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the official API, or the raw string when not JSON. Example: {}.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default official API call for this instance when input.operation is blank. EXACT accepted values: project_create, project_get, project_list, project_update, project_delete, task_create, task_get, task_list, task_search, task_update, task_delete, task_move, subtask_create, subtask_list, comment_add, comment_remove, tag_add, tag_remove, project_add_task, project_remove_task, user_get, user_list, listen. Default: project_create. Example: project_create.

configurationParameters.label: Personal Access Token
